mapper.sql: permission_approves.id AS id, permission_approves.type_id AS `type`, permission_approves.name AS `name`, permission_approves.from_amount AS fromAmount, permission_approves.to_amount AS toAmount, permission_approves.is_cash_advance AS isCashAdvance, permission_approves.is_cod AS isCod, permission_approves.created AS created, permission_approves.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM permission_approves LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = permission_approves.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = permission_approves.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission_approves ( type_id, `name`, from_amount, to_amount, is_cash_advance, is_cod, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{permissionApprove.type}, #{permissionApprove.name}, #{permissionApprove.fromAmount}, #{permissionApprove.toAmount}, #{permissionApprove.isCashAdvance}, #{permissionApprove.isCod}, NOW(), #{permissionApprove.createdBy}, #{permissionApprove.isActive} )
INSERT INTO permission_approve_details (user_id, permission_approve_id, status) VALUES (#{userPermissionApprove.userId}, #{userPermissionApprove.permissionApproveId}, 1);

INSERT INTO permission_approve_projects (permission_approve_id, ut_type_of_system_id, status) VALUES (#{departmentPermissionApprove.permissionApproveId}, #{departmentPermissionApprove.departmentId}, 1);
mapper.update: UPDATE permission_approve_details SET status = -1 WHERE permission_approve_id = #{permissionApproveId};
UPDATE permission_approve_projects SET status = -1 WHERE permission_approve_id = #{permissionApproveId};
mapper.select: SELECT permission_approve_details.user_id AS id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS name FROM permission_approve_details LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = permission_approve_details.user_id WHERE users.is_active = 1 AND permission_approve_details.status = 1 AND permission_approve_details.permission_approve_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE permission_approves SET type_id = #{permissionApprove.type}, `name` = #{permissionApprove.name}, from_amount = #{permissionApprove.fromAmount}, to_amount = #{permissionApprove.toAmount}, is_cash_advance = #{permissionApprove.isCashAdvance}, is_cod = #{permissionApprove.isCod}, is_active = #{permissionApprove.isActive}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{permissionApprove.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{permissionApprove.id}
